findings.summary: Task 15b delegates production application of the writer-function revocation migration to Task 13 Step 3, but that step applies only roles and SELECT grants and its setup allowlist excludes the revocation migration, leaving production's required privilege check blocked when PUBLIC retains those permissions.

Typed task targets remain incomplete: Task 20 omits creation of lease.mjs and lease.test.mjs, Task 15b omits its separate writer-function migration, rollback and test, Task 14 omits maintainer.env and env-refs.test.mjs changes, and Task 11 omits creating the allowlist that Task 15b declares as a modification, leaving required implementation work outside the declared targets.
